main.description: A feed, hydrated. Served by the AppView: it resolves the generator record to its service, calls getFeedSkeleton, and hydrates the result under its own policy (deleted records, deactivated authors, community hides, the non-member rule, closed postings), dropping whatever it cannot show. For a personalised feed, send a service auth token with aud = the generator's DID (generatorView.did) and lxm = sh.authentiq.feed.getFeedSkeleton; the AppView verifies it for viewer state and forwards it to the generator.

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: No valid generator record at that URI.

errors.name: FeedUnavailable
errors.description: The generator could not be resolved or reached, timed out, or answered with something that is not a skeleton.
